package.name: duro_sim
package.description: Stands in for the attitude SwiftNav Duro of a dual-antenna RTK heading setup in the simulator: publishes the moving-baseline swiftnav_ros2_driver/Baseline (attitude antenna relative to the reference antenna) computed from the two antennas' simulated NavSatFix, as the real sbp-to-ros driver would with a fixed RTK solution.
